data.name: Meta_Description
data.value: Explore SharpTS results from the pinned Test262 and TypeScript conformance corpora.

data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Browse real results from the exact SharpTS revision running this site, from broad language areas down to individual built-ins and features.

data.name: PercentageFootnote
data.value: Percentages count Pass results over all non-skipped results. Every other non-skipped bucket counts as not passing; skipped results are shown separately.

data.name: HonestyFootnote
data.value: Test262 exercises specification edge cases far beyond what typical programs encounter. These totals are presented without adjustment.
